# Leveling a Druid — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on balance (1 member), feral-bear (9 members), feral-cat (17 members), restoration (8 members). The main line is **feral-cat** — Endgame build (level 60), 11/35/5, with a respec at level 30, 60. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/druid/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

- **-110 — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone** (`DC00u-elemental-stone`, level 50+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a dagger); the main hand does not have Consecrated Weapon; not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Elemental Sharpening Stone; (the main hand does not have Sharpen Weapon - Critical or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.

#### Levels 60–60

- **72 — Rip** (`DC08a-rip-endgame`, level 60+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; the target does not have Rip; the combo points are on the target; at least 30 energy; the target is not immune to mechanic 15; (at least 5 combo points or at least 2 combo points and the target dies in less than 30 s).
- **73 — Shred** (`DC11b-shred-clearcasting-at-five`, level 60+) — When: the resident has Clearcasting; the target is hostile; in melee range; the resident is behind the target; at least 5 combo points; the combo points are on the target; the target has Rip; the target's Rip time left is at least 3 s.
- **74 — Ferocious Bite** (`DC09a-bite-carnage`, level 60+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; at least 5 combo points; the combo points are on the target; at least 35 energy; (the target has Rip or the target is immune to mechanic 15).
- **111 — Reshift** (`DC16-reshift-cat`, level 60+) — When: the resident has Cat Form; in combat; the target is hostile; in melee range; fewer than 28 energy; the resident does not have Clearcasting; (the resident does not have Tiger's Fury or time since the resident cast Tiger's Fury is at least 15 s); form mana at least 50%; time since the resident cast Reshift is at least 6 s.

### Restoration

#### Levels 10–19

- **-1 — Aquatic Form** (`DS00q-aquatic-form`, level 16+) — When: the resident is swimming; not in combat; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **2 — Regrowth** (`DS00i-prepull-regrowth`, level 12+) — When: the tank is about to pull; the target has Rejuvenation; the target does not have Regrowth; the resident is not moving; mana at least 40%; at least 96 mana; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **106 — Abolish Poison** (`DS08m-abolish-poison-must`, level 14+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **109 — Regrowth** (`DS11t-regrowth-tank`, level 12+) — When: in combat; target health below 70%; the target does not have Regrowth; the resident is not moving; mana at least 40%; at least 96 mana; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **110 — Regrowth** (`DS11-regrowth`, level 12+) — When: target health below 60%; the target does not have Regrowth; the resident is not moving; at least 96 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the target lives at least 2500 ms; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **136 — Abolish Poison** (`DS08-abolish-poison`, level 14+) — When: the target has a dispellable poison effect; mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **137 — Cure Poison** (`DS09-cure-poison`, level 14+) — When: the target has a dispellable poison effect; the target does not have Abolish Poison; mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.

#### Levels 20–29

- **-107 — Use Elixir of Fortitude** (`DS00u-fortitude`, level 25+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of Fortitude; Elixir of Fortitude is off cooldown; the resident does not have Health II.
- **7 — Rebirth** (`DS07-rebirth`, level 20+) — When: a dead party member within 30 yd; Rebirth is off cooldown; the resident is not moving; mana at least 34%; no party member below 35% health; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **60 — Swiftmend** (`DS06-swiftmend`, level 20+) — When: target health below 40%; (the target has Rejuvenation or the target has Regrowth); Swiftmend is off cooldown; mana at least 30%; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **105 — Remove Curse** (`DS09m-remove-curse-must`, level 24+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **138 — Remove Curse** (`DS09c-remove-curse`, level 24+) — When: the target has a dispellable curse effect; mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.

#### Levels 30–39

- **-106 — Use Nightfin Soup** (`DS00u-nightfin`, level 35+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Nightfin Soup; Nightfin Soup is off cooldown; the resident does not have Mana Regeneration.
- **50 — Nature's Swiftness** (`DS05-natures-swiftness`, level 30+) — When: in combat; the lowest party health below 30%; Nature's Swiftness is off cooldown; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form; the resident does not have Tree of Life Form.
- **100 — Tranquility** (`DS10-tranquility`, level 30+) — When: at least 5 party members below 50% health; the resident is not moving; Tranquility is off cooldown; at least 750 mana; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.

#### Levels 40–49

- **-110 — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil** (`DS00u-wizard-oil`, level 45+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Wizard Oil; (the main hand does not have Brilliant Wizard Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **-109 — Use Mageblood Potion** (`DS00u-mageblood`, level 40+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Mageblood Potion; Mageblood Potion is off cooldown; the resident does not have Mana Regeneration.
- **-108 — Use Dreamshard Elixir** (`DS00u-dreamshard`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Dreamshard Elixir; Dreamshard Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Dreamshard Elixir.
- **-104 — Use Limited Invulnerability Potion** (`DS00u-limited-invulnerability`, level 45+) — When: in combat; own health below 30%; carries Limited Invulnerability Potion; Limited Invulnerability Potion is off cooldown; the resident does not have Invulnerability.
- **30 — Innervate** (`DS03-innervate`, level 40+) — When: mana below 20%; Innervate is off cooldown; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **40 — Barkskin** (`DS04-barkskin`, level 44+) — When: own health below 40%; Barkskin is off cooldown; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **49 — cancel form** (`DS00u-leave-tree-for-swiftness-heal`, level 40+) — When: the resident has Tree of Life Form; in combat; the lowest party health below 30%; Nature's Swiftness is off cooldown.
- **99 — cancel form** (`DS00v-leave-tree-for-tranquility`, level 40+) — When: the resident has Tree of Life Form; at least 5 party members below 50% health; the resident is not moving; Tranquility is off cooldown; at least 750 mana.

#### Levels 50–59

- **-105 — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea** (`DS00u-tea`, level 55+) — When: in combat; mana below 25%; carries Nordanaar Herbal Tea; Nordanaar Herbal Tea is off cooldown.

#### Levels 60–60

- **8 — Tree of Life Form** (`DS00t-tree-of-life-form`, level 60+) — When: the party has a living member; (in combat or the tank is about to pull); the resident does not have Tree of Life Form; the lowest party health at least 45%; not a dead party member within 30 yd; not (at least 5 party members below 50% health and Tranquility is off cooldown); mana at least 50%; the resident is not swimming; the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
- **9 — cancel form** (`DS00w-leave-tree-between-pulls`, level 60+) — When: the resident has Tree of Life Form; not in combat; the tank is not about to pull; time since the resident cast Tree of Life Form is at least 20 s.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Balance

- **DB00q-aquatic-form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (owner, 2026-10-08: druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims; the party buff is the shaman's or warlock's (HO-TKB-PLAY-139)): in water and out of combat, Aquatic Form (1066, quest at 16, instant): it breathes underwater and swims faster, so the druid needs no breath buff (p4-group's swim hold counts a druid as covered). self.swimming is the map's liquid at the resident (v28).
- **DB00r-rebirth:** Castable in caster form, not in Moonkin Form (level 30) (archive); reagent Maple Seed 17034, which the runtime refuses no_reagent before the push when absent. HO-TKB-PLAY-115 (decision 177): `not aura_self(24858)`: the guide's Balance table takes Moonkin Form at 30 (guide/classes/druid/leveling.md L60-L86), and the spell cannot be cast in it (spell_template.stancesNot).
- **DB01-mark-of-the-wild:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DB02-thorns:** It carries stances 1 << 30 with SPELL_ATTR_EX2_NOT_NEED_SHAPESHIFT, which is the pattern every caster spell in this file follows: legal unshifted, better in a form this build does not take. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DB02b-thorns-self:** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).

### Feral Bear

- **DR00q-aquatic-form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (owner, 2026-10-08: druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims; the party buff is the shaman's or warlock's (HO-TKB-PLAY-139)): in water and out of combat, Aquatic Form (1066, quest at 16, instant): it breathes underwater and swims faster, so the druid needs no breath buff (p4-group's swim hold counts a druid as covered). self.swimming is the map's liquid at the resident (v28).
- **DR00w-mark-of-the-wild:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22: a party whose only druid is feral got no Mark of the Wild): the restoration file's DS01 (party_missing, out of combat, not while drinking or eating), in caster form only, so it never takes the druid out of a form. It sits above the form rules, so in the caster-form window after a drink, a meal or a resurrection the buff goes out before the shift.
- **DR00x-thorns-tank:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129: the restoration file's DS02 (Thorns on the party tank, the resident when it tanks) in caster form only, as the Mark above. HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic (1066) or Travel (783) Form: SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT, the cat file already had both.
- **DR00y-thorns-self:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129: solo, Thorns on the druid itself (DS02b), in caster form only.
- **DR01-dire-bear-form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-167 (PIONEER FIX, owner's loop pass after PIO-053): the aura test now also asks for 5487. Dire Bear Form (9634) is rank 2 of the Bear Form chain: the core casts it (rank_id 9634) but the CAST_SUCCESS and the aura both carry the first-in-chain id 5487, and auras_self lists first-in-chain ids (state-vocabulary), so `not aura_self(9634)` was true on every tick and the rule re-cast the form every 1.5 s, in combat too (round 144: 788 such casts on three bear tanks, Cressa on 5487 in 3255 of 3333 ticks and never on 9634; Cressa 2209, Mirethal, Ivenna).
- **DR02-bear-form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (P1L39-C1): not while swimming: Aquatic Form holds in water, and on land or in combat the loop's stance push shifts back. Free, permanent, ShapeshiftForm bit 1 << 4, and a quest ability at 10 rather than a trainer one.
- **DR03l-growl-loose:** Growl reaches 5 yd (rangeIndex 2) and is off the global cooldown; the rule is for the bear (the file declares Bear Form as its stance).
- **DR05-frenzied-regeneration:** The only self-heal a bear has, since every healing spell the class owns carries a stancesNot mask this form is inside. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DR06-barkskin-feral:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **DR07c-bash-caster:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Runners: Feral Charge (from Bear) or Bash" (druid/leveling.md L159). 10 rage, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, a 2 s stun; the interrupt, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **DR07-bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Runners: Feral Charge (from Bear) or Bash" (druid/leveling.md L159). 10 rage, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, a 2 s stun; the interrupt, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **DR08-enrage:** At the pin Enrage is scripted (spell_druid_enrage, bound to 5229 by a world update) to cast 25503 for -27 per cent base armour in Bear Form, so a bear already under half health pays the armour where it hurts.
- **DR09-feral-charge:** Feral talent (274) taken at 20; 5 rage, 15 s recoveryTime, 25 yd, and it closes and interrupts.
- **DR11b-demoralizing-roar-boss:** HO-TKB-PLAY-171 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator ruling "Roar only", observer's Hateforge fix 4): on a boss entry of the dungeon plan (target.boss) Demoralizing Roar goes out on the first tick the boss is inside 10 yd, ahead of Faerie Fire (Feral) at 105 and Swipe at 107.
- **DR12-faerie-fire-feral:** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): in bear or cat only (stances 145): SPELL_FAILED_ONLY_SHAPESHIFT out of form.
- **DR15b-moonfire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (orchestrator: levels 1-10 before the forms): Moonfire rank 1 (8921, trainer at level 4, 25 mana) once per mob, the archive's caster phase: "From level 4, cast Moonfire once per mob" and then Wrath. Same guards as the Wrath rule beside it: in no form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634), standing, and not while the target already carries it.
- **DR05a-entangling-roots-second:** The runtime backs a spell off after two pushes in a row that leave no aura on the target (p1-loop v12, ineffective_backoff for 10 s on that guid), so a creature that shrugs it off costs two casts, not a fight.
- **DR15a-wrath:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (p3-runtime, the level-1 window): this file had no ability rule below the form level, so a feral druid of level 1-10 fought on auto-attack alone. Guarded out of every form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634: a form cannot cast it) and below the approach rule, which is the staff melee once the mana is gone.

- **DR00u-free-action-rattlegore:** Rattlegore (11622) stuns; the Scholomance guide: pop a Free Action Potion 5-10 s into the fight so his stun misses (aura 6615, mechanic 11 immunity).
- **DR14a-reshift-bear:** HO-TKB-PLAY-240 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Reshift (cancel and reapply the current form, core spell_druid_reshift) when rage-starved: guide L103 "for a burst of rage when rage-starved, do not overdo it, since it costs Maul uptime", L19 "sparingly". Furor 5/5 gives 10 rage on the form aura (DB 17057, SpellAuras.cpp furor chance).
- **DR00u-greater-stoneshield-boss:** HO-TKB-PLAY-218 (PIONEER FIX, endgame specs programme; kit sync ruling 2026-10-18: the kit is generated from the rules, so an item the guide wants needs a rule): Greater Stoneshield Potion (item 13455, required level 46, aura 17540 Greater Stoneshield, armour) on a boss once the tank has threat. No boss-burst list exists for our dungeons, so the trigger is the boss flag with threat opened and health at 60 per cent or more: a proxy, open question.
- **DR00v-leave-bear-for-mark:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): the bear never left its form to buff members (DR00w casts in caster form only): out of combat in a party, in Bear or Dire Bear Form, with a living member lacking Mark of the Wild or Gift of the Wild (party.any_missing(1126), v43) it cancels the form so DR00w casts and DR01/DR02 re-enter. The exact rule of HO-TKB-PLAY-240 (level_min 10 instead of 20: the bear has the form from 10); the 60 percent floor on self.form_mana_pct (the druid's own mana, read while shapeshifted: Tick.cpp L1387-L1391, not rage or energy) is the cat rule DC00v's.

The previous note declined any reserve at all on a VALUE argument ("what a battle rez is worth against a bar is a judgement the pin does not make - a raised tank is worth more than any number of Regrowths"), which is still true and still a different question from whether the cast can complete; `mana_pct >= 34` answers the second question only.
